about: Where pin_freshness.py (humemai/mmdbbench#175, item 1) reads the releases of every pin. An image entry names the version its digest stands for, so a new digest needs a new version here (test_pin_freshness.py). `stable` picks the stable releases (group v is the version). `compatible.tags` narrows them to the ones every lane can use and names the row of comparator_constraints.json that says why. `exception` is the `backend` of an exception line there. `own` marks ArcadeDB and its client layer, which are listed and not judged. A Python package with no entry is read from PyPI and has no hold.
